children: South Korea’s trade surplus increased to USD 34.75 billion in August 2026, up from USD 6.40 billion in the same month a year earlier, surpassing market expectations of USD 30.7 billion and marking the 19th consecutive month of surplus as exports continued to outpace imports, flash data showed.

Exports surged 68.7% year-on-year to USD 98.25 billion, accelerating from an upwardly revised 63% jump in July, mainly driven by a surge in semiconductor shipments, which rose for the 15th consecutive month.
Meanwhile, imports rose 22.5% year-on-year to USD 63.51 billion, easing from 26.5% growth in July, supported by resilient domestic demand.

title: South Korea Trade Surplus Beats Estimates
